hint: The images show the same moment from {n} fixed camera{s}. A robot hand, palm up, holds a cube whose faces are coloured. The hand may hide parts of the cube.

up: Which colour covers most of the cube face that points straight up (toward the sky, away from the robot palm)?
turned: The cube consists of a larger 2/3 base and a thinner 1/3 rotatable cap (which has a white face with a black bar). On the four coloured side faces (red, green, yellow, blue), does each thin 1/3 strip have the same colour as the large 2/3 panel it sits on, or a different colour?
Aligned: each thin 1/3 strip matches the colour of its large 2/3 panel
Misaligned: the thin 1/3 strips have different colours from the large 2/3 panels they sit on
band: The thinner 1/3 white cap has a black bar on its white face pointing toward its own red 1/3 side strip. Which colour of the large 2/3 base face is that red 1/3 strip (and the black bar) currently aligned with?
